stemMd: Boiling liquid water primarily overcomes which interactions?

options.label: B
options.textMd: All nuclear forces in oxygen atoms

options.label: C
options.textMd: All covalent O–H bonds within every molecule

explanationMd: Boiling separates molecules into the gas phase. Their O–H covalent bonds remain intact; energy is used to overcome intermolecular attractions rather than split water into its elements.

distractorRationale.a: Water molecules are not a peptide chain.
distractorRationale.c: Ordinary boiling does not decompose water.
distractorRationale.b: Boiling is not a nuclear process.
